title: skills(objectstack-upgrade): the §3.3 acceptance replay names the last ported hop and can fail

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-upgrade` §3.3 的验收回放不再从目标主版本起跑(在最高主版本上那是空区间,`applied` 永远是 `[]`,检查永远过)。改为回放整段移植区间 `--from <authored-major> --to <target-major> --json`(与 quickstart 第 1 步同一区间),要求 `applied: []` 且 JSON 里没有 `replayedNothing`(#29045 合入后,没跑任何一步时 `--json` 会带这个键)。quickstart 第 74 行与文内另三处同一回放的提法改成一致;两条练这项检查的 eval 的期望同步。提示框里举的 `field-required-notnull-explicit` 已在 conversions registry 撤回,提示框不再点名任何 conversion;报告模板(examples-upgrade.md)的示例行改用 registry 真有的 `sharing-rule-access-level-full-to-edit`,其 Verified 行改为全区间回放「replay 16 → 18」。
- 为什么改:按原文执行的 agent 会记录一条从未检查任何东西的「元数据已规范」验收。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文本与其 eval;无代码、无门禁变动。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`SKILL.md` L74、L388–411;`evals/protocol-major-upgrade.json` 第 1、4 条;`references/examples-upgrade.md` L48、L54。
- 棘轮:token 棘轮就地付账,无 re-wrap。SKILL.md 删了两处同文件复述(见下),6185 → 6160 tokens,天花板 6188 未动;examples-upgrade.md 1194 → 1189 / 1197。
- 需要你做的:Tier H,等维护者的字。

## What changes

1. **§3.3 Validate** (`skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L397–411). The replay that closes the gap after a green `validate` is now `os migrate meta --from <authored-major> --to <target-major> --json`, the whole range the sources were ported through (the `--from` of §0, the range quickstart step 1 replays), and the criterion is `applied` must be `[]` **and** `replayedNothing` absent. `composeMigrationChain` keeps `m > fromMajor && m <= toMajor`, so a replay from the major below the target would leave out every earlier hop; the whole range is non-empty whenever the crossing has a step and sees every hop. The paragraph that followed, which said `--to` defaults to one past the installed major so only `todos` carries the next major's residue, is replaced: it explains that `--from <target-major>` proves nothing, because `--to` defaults to the highest major this build carries a step for, so the range is empty (no step runs, `applied` is `[]` whatever the metadata holds, and the JSON says so with `replayedNothing`, whose `widestRange` is `null` there because no wider range exists from that `--from`) or holds only the next major's step. `todos` stays Layer 2's business, not a failure. `--to` is in the command listing at L143 already.
2. **Quickstart L74** now reads `os migrate meta --from 16 --to 18 --json   # \`applied\` [] and no \`replayedNothing\` (see §3.3)`, which is §3.3's command for the quickstart's 16 → 18 crossing (step 1 replays `--from 16`). The card read L74 as unaffected; `--to 18` pins the range so the two lines say the same thing on a build that already carries a later step.
3. **The callout's example** (L388–394). `field-required-notnull-explicit` is withdrawn from `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` (its docblock exists to stop it being re-added), and every conversion this build ships is `retiredFromLoadPath` with its old shape refused at parse, so no migration-chain-only conversion exists on this head. The callout keeps the class and its reason, says this build ships none and a later one can, and names no conversion. The report template's example row (`references/examples-upgrade.md` L54, surface widened by the seat in 6594782842) named the same withdrawn id; it now shows the step-17 conversion `sharing-rule-access-level-full-to-edit` at the site shape the chain prints, `sharingRules[0].accessLevel` `'full'` → `'edit'` (`mapCollection` spells array sites by index; the conversion's own fixture is a `sharingRules` entry). No `notnull-explicit` mention remains under `skills/`. The same template's **Verified** line (L48, surface widened again in 6594814065) said "replay-from-17 applies 0 mechanical changes" under "Chain: 16 → 18", the last-hop form M1 retired; it now says "replay 16 → 18 applies 0 mechanical changes".
4. **Three other mentions of the same replay** in the file, so no line still says "from the target major": the §3.5 evidence row ("Only the acceptance replay sees this class."), the failure-mode row for `--write` ("then replay the ported range to confirm 0 changes") and the row "Replay from the target major still applies changes" → "The acceptance replay still applies changes".
5. **Evals 1 and 4** (`evals/protocol-major-upgrade.json`) expect `os migrate meta --from 16 --to 17 --json` (a one-hop crossing, where the ported range is that hop) with `applied: []` and no `replayedNothing`, and say why `--from 17` alone checks nothing. Eval 4's `must_contain` gains `replayedNothing` and drops `field-required-notnull-explicit`; its `expected_output` no longer names a conversion. Eval fixtures are measured, not ratcheted.

The `replayedNothing` reading is taken from the merged CLI, `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts`: `readReplayedNothing` returns `null` when `result.hops.length > 0`, else `{ reason: 'empty-range' | 'inverted-range', widestRange: { from, to, applied, manual } | null }`; `--json` spreads it into the payload only in that case, next to `applied`, `todos` and `absentTodos`. `composeMigrationChain` keeps the majors `m > fromMajor && m <= toMajor`, so `--from 18` on this build (steps to 17 and 18, `CHAIN_TERMINUS_MAJOR` 18) composes zero steps.

### Token ratchet (paid in place, no re-wrap)

`skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`: 6185 → 6160 tokens, ceiling 6188 (headroom 3 → 28). `references/examples-upgrade.md`: 1194 → 1189 tokens, ceiling 1197 (headroom 3 → 8), one row replaced by a shorter one and one line reworded in place (+2 bytes), no re-wrap. The ceiling row in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not touched (second file, out of surface). Two genuine deletions of same-file restatement pay for the added text:

| deleted | home |
|:--|:--|
| §1 bullet "**Pending data migrations**, when the chain crosses into a major with per-deployment data gates — see below." (2 lines) | the §1 subsection "Data migrations are not metadata migrations", directly below, which says what the run prints and what to carry into the report |
| failure-mode row "`validate` green from the start, so 'there was nothing to upgrade' … `validate` green is necessary, not sufficient; see 3.3" (1 line) | §3.3's own callout, titled "A green `validate` does NOT mean the chain has nothing left to do", which the row restated and pointed back to |

Every other block is byte-identical to `main`. Line counts: SKILL.md 482 → 482, examples-upgrade.md unchanged.

## Why

Card #29063 (filed from the #28947 dev, PR #29045): when the target is the highest major this build carries a step for, `os migrate meta --from <target-major> --json` is an empty range, so an agent following §3.3 records a canonical-metadata acceptance that never examined anything. Now that `--json` carries `replayedNothing` when no step ran, the skill can name a range that can fail and a key whose presence means the check never ran.
